summary: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen-based foreign private issuer in the bolts, nuts, screws, rivets and washers industry, furnished a Form 6-K to provide unaudited consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2026, a related operating and financial review, and a press release reporting first-half fiscal 2026 results. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is stated. The filing is a routine interim earnings disclosure with no special-situation element; monitor ordinary operating results and any subsequent capital-markets activity.
